_readme: Token tree for hq.vevo.com, read 2026-11-21. Each leaf is a computed style from raw/components-computed.json or a painted element sampled in the same headless Chromium session (raw/brand-probe.json). Wix custom properties are layout internals (--one-unit, --section-max-width) and are not the visual system. One light theme. The site paints section grounds, not a token ramp.

core.$description: Scales and primitives measured on the public marketing site.

black.source: computed backgroundColor of button default and footer band (raw/components-computed.json, homepage painted-element probe)
black.description: Primary button fill, footer band, and ink on light pages.

white.source: computed color of nav-link text and backgroundColor of the About Us pill (raw/components-computed.json)
white.description: Text on dark heroes and the light pill fill.

inkSoft.source: computed color of button hover text and backgroundColor of text-link hover (raw/components-computed.json)
inkSoft.description: Near-black used when a black control inverts on hover.

paper.source: computed color of text-link hover text and backgroundColor of button hover (raw/components-computed.json)
paper.description: Off-white of the inverted hover button.

navHover.description: Header link colour while the pointer is over it.

crimson.source: painted backgroundColor of the homepage By the numbers band, and borderTopColor of text-field blurred-empty (homepage painted-element probe, raw/components-computed.json)
crimson.description: The one brand red: the stats band, and the invalid field border.

slate.source: painted backgroundColor of the advertiser contact page (form-page probe, 2026-11-21)

sans.source: computed fontFamily of body, with the Wix hashed face (wfont_08392a_c1f9747dda3c4c4889c513212) stripped because it is a hosted cut, not a public family name (raw/components-computed.json). The loaded document.font family was wf_c1f9747dda3c4c4889c513212. The public name of that cut was Not captured.
sans.description: Fallback stack only. The real face is a Wix-hosted cut whose public name was not readable.

16.source: About Us pill and text-link textStyle.fontSize

74.source: homepage 22 Billion figure fontSize, painted-element probe

regular.source: computed fontWeight of nav-link, button, hero-heading and the stats figure

$extensions.source: text-link and About Us pill textStyle
text-field fontSize. Line height was the keyword normal and is not a length.

pill.source: borderRadius of the About Us pill, painted-element probe

hairline.source: borderTopWidth of text-field, select and text-area

header.source: header getBoundingClientRect height 76.7px, rounded, painted-element probe. Derived from that reading.

button.source: rendered height of button and the About Us pill

field.source: rendered height of text-field and select

checkbox.source: rendered width and height of checkbox and radio

light.$description: The only theme the public site paints. Section grounds change per page. There is no dark theme switch.

page.source: painted background of the homepage root (rgb(255, 255, 255), 1440x5766)

hero.source: painted black band behind the homepage hero photo

footer.source: footer band on the advertiser contact page

primary.source: about heading color and field color

onDark.source: nav-link textStyle.color and hero heading color

onAccent.source: stats figure color on the crimson band

field.source: text-field default borderTopColor on the slate form

invalid.source: text-field blurred-empty borderTopColor. The field was blurred empty. The form was not submitted.

default.source: the stats band. No separate hover or pressed accent was measured.

selected.source: drawer-link borderTopColor and drawer textStyle.color for the current Home item at 390 (raw/components-computed.json). Observed in mobile-home-light-menu.png as a purple current item.

bg.source: text-field backgroundColor. The fill is transparent. The slate page shows through.
